tension: Indian consumers are seeking a holistic approach to wellness, with a focus on gut health and digestion, driven by cultural associations and increasing awareness of the importance of overall health. This has led to a growing demand for science-led supplements that cater to these needs.
why_now: The recent funding raised by The Good Bug and Foodstories, as well as the growing conversation around ashwagandha and gut health, indicate a ripe market for wellness products that address these concerns. With increasing health awareness and a rising demand for natural supplements, the time is opportune for The Good Bug to establish itself as a leader in the science-led synbiotic supplements space.
